connector.name: PostHog MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Official PostHog MCP Server for product analytics, feature flags, experiments, and more.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.posthog.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the posthog account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token with your PostHog personal API key. Create one at https://us.posthog.com/settings/user-api-keys with the 'MCP Server' preset.
